tables.notes:
Fix from the previous answer: the slab data is not generated in memory. utils/slab_data.py:76-79 loads pickles from data/datasets/slab/, which the dry run failed to find. They are created by data_gen_syn.py (repo root, no arguments), which writes them for seeds 0-9, slab noise 0.0 and 0.1, spur corr 0.0/0.1/0.2/0.9 and train/val/test (data_gen_syn.py:35-98). It is now the single data step. Note that utils/slab_data.py:75 hardcodes an absolute /home/t-dimaha/... base_dir, but the dry-run traceback shows a relative data/datasets/slab/ path, so the generated files should be found as-is.

All train/eval commands are unchanged from reproduce_scripts/reproduce_slab.py ('train' and 'evaluate' cases, with n_runs=10 taken from total_seed). No values were taken from the paper.

Source 1 and Source 2 come from the eval step (test.py --test_metric per_domain_acc --acc_data_case train). It prints one 'Per Domain Acc' line per domain per run (evaluation/per_domain_acc.py:79), with runs split on the 'Data Case: train' line printed by data/slab_loader.py. Target comes from the train log: the last 'Current Best Epoch k with Test Accuracy v' line of each 'Run N' block, which is the per-run target accuracy at the best source-validation epoch. The code prints no per-run summary line, so this per-epoch line is used instead of the whole-log summary.

Row mapping: CDANN is script method c-dann; CORAL and C-CORAL use method_name mmd with --gaussian 0; PerfMatch is match_case 1.0; RandMatch is match_case 0.0.

tables.notes:
All trained rows (ERM, RandMatch, MatchDG, PerfMatch) use the commands in reproduce_scripts/reproduce_rmnist_lenet.py, with one command per target domain and the other five domains as train domains. The script's train_domains string is written as separate argv tokens here. I took the data size of 1000 samples per domain (--subset_size 1000) from the paper (supplement C.1). The README only shows the ResNet-18 data generation with subset_size 2000. I used --model lenet --img_h 32 --img_w 32 to match the script's lenet setup and data/data_gen_mnist.py:214. The data directory is rot_mnist_lenet, which matches --mnist_case lenet.

The per-run number comes from train.py's per-epoch line 'Current Best Epoch: k with Test Accuracy: v' (algorithms/erm_match.py:160 and match_dg.py:386). The last such line in each 'Run n' block is the test accuracy at the best source-validation epoch. This equals the per-run value behind train.py:314 'Final Test Accuracy (Source Validation)'. I did not use that summary line because it is printed over all runs. n_runs defaults to 3 and n_runs_matchdg_erm defaults to 1, so there are 3 runs per cell. No separate test.py evaluation is needed, because train.py computes test accuracy itself.

MatchDG has two phases. Phase 1 is matchdg_ctr and Phase 2 is matchdg_erm. The number is read from the Phase 2 log (step erm_phase). Both phases run all 3 seeds in turn with the same settings.

The Average columns are derived as the mean of the six target-domain cells. CCSA, D-MTAE, LabelGrad, DAN, CrossGrad and DIVA are copied from Shankar et al. 2018 and Ilse et al. 2020, so they are unlinked.
